subject: MAP sequencing & close chronology for MedSprint pilot
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@medsprint.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medsprint.com
Date: 2028-03-22T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP sequencing & legal dependencies for pilot

Hi Laura / Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is a first-pass MAP (MedSprint-MAP-v1.xlsx) that includes our evaluation milestones and the approvals we need on the contract side. High level items we need to sync on:

- Order of approvals: SOW -> MSA signature -> DPA parallel review? We need clarity if your DPA can be signed concurrently with MSA or must follow.
- Evidence pack: SOC2 artifacts + data retention process (we attached a checklist).
- Expected sign-off owners and approximate lead times (security review: 7–10 business days; procurement legal: 5 business days).

Proposed timeline: evaluation kickoff Apr 2; completion by May 15; contract signature window May 20–30 (tight). If we can lock sequencing now we can align our internal procurement calendar.

Can we do a short sequencing call today or tomorrow to confirm who signs what and when?

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Procurement | MedSprint Health
olivia.chen@medsprint.com
+1 415-555-0193

Attachments: MedSprint-MAP-v1.xlsx; SOC2-evidence-index.xlsx

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@medsprint.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP sequencing & legal dependencies for pilot

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for sending the MAP and the SOC2 checklist. This is helpful. Quick thoughts after a read-through:

1) DPA timing: Redwood prefers the DPA to be executed with or immediately after the MSA to avoid a two-step signature process. Practically we can work in parallel (legal and security review at same time) but ask that signatures close together (same signature event).

2) Order form/SOW: we can provisionally finalize the SOW in parallel with the MSA review. To avoid procurement stalls, we suggest a conditional order form that references a final SOW attached to the MSA (so commercial terms are mutually visible while legal finishes redlines).

3) Evidence windows: we'll provide the SOC2 index and a scoped evidence bundle by Mar 29. We recommend your security team do a light review first week of Apr; if anything deeper is required we'll add an acceptance gate in the MAP.

4) Risk items to call out now: data residency clause and backup retention (we flagged these in the annotated MSA draft). Karthik, if you can review the redline I dropped into the draft PDF and call out any non-standard clauses, that would be great.

I can do a 30-min sync at 3:30pm PT today if that works for you. If not, tomorrow morning.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
(415) 555-0114

Attachments: Redwood-MSA-draft-annotated.pdf

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-22T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP sequencing & legal dependencies for pilot

Laura / Marcus —

Quick internal note before the call: I reviewed the annotated MSA. Main points to escalate to MedSprint:

- Data processing scope: request we limit processing subtypes to what is necessary for the pilot (helps reduce DPA exposure).
- Indemnity cap language: propose a pilot-specific cap tied to fees for the first 12 months.
- Audit clause: accept but prefer scheduled audits vs. open-ended.

I'll join the sync and go over redlines live. If MedSprint is amenable to a pilot-limited MSA bundle, we can accelerate approval.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Legal | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Laura / Karthik —

Thanks, this is clear. Tom and I talked through your suggested flow and we are comfortable doing the DPA in tandem with MSA review, provided signatures happen in the same signature event. We agree to a pilot-limited scope for processing and are ok with a capped indemnity for the pilot term.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- MedSprint security provides a light-review summary by 2028-04-06.
- Procurement/legal will aim to consolidate comments by 2028-04-13.
- Target signature date: week of 2028-05-22 (allows for internal board review).

We are attaching an updated MAP with dates and a revised SOW outline — see attachment column "target-dates". If those dates work on your end, we'll route for internal approval.

Olivia

Appreciate the quick alignment. I consolidated the sequencing into a single-source MAP sheet and added acceptance gates, owner names, and fallback dates (link below). Key commitments:

- Redwood delivers SOC2 evidence index by 2028-03-29.
- MedSprint security light-review by 2028-04-06.
- Legal redline consolidation by 2028-04-13.
- Target signature week: 2028-05-22 (MSA + DPA signed same day); order form to follow same day.
